propositions: No alerting or warning fires when Pass-2 verify runs but an LLM-tier decided finding lacks a verification block; the absence signal `verification_recorded` is completely unimplemented

DET-tier detector findings and indeterminate findings with reason='no-verification' legitimately lack verification blocks because they never enter Pass-2, so an unscoped signal would produce standing false alarms
`verification` blocks are correctly persisted by `pass3_over_findings` and preserved through `build_payload`'s field-spread operation, contradicting the original premise that blocks are dropped

The detection predicate must scope to LLM-tier findings where `tier == 'LLM'` AND `decision != 'indeterminate'` AND `reason != 'no-verification'` to avoid false positives on routine runs with legitimate blockless findings
Metrics-level advisory signal must be added to `coverage['metrics']` with a WARNING log naming missing-vs-expected count when the predicate is false and `verify_requests > 0`
